title: P.7 Inverse Trigonometric Functions

icans: I can find exact values of inverse trigonometric functions.
I can evaluate composites of trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions.
I can solve trigonometric equations on [0, 2π).

vocab: y = sin⁻¹ x __________ x = sin y, where −1 ≤ x ≤ 1 and −π/2 ≤ y ≤ π/2
y = cos⁻¹ x __________ x = cos y, where −1 ≤ x ≤ 1 and 0 ≤ y ≤ π
y = tan⁻¹ x __________ x = tan y, where −π/2 < y < π/2

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Inverse sine: y = sin⁻¹ x means x = sin y, where −1 ≤ x ≤ 1 and _______________ ≤ y ≤ π/2.

blocks.stem:
Find the exact value.
a.  sin⁻¹(√2/2)
b.  sin⁻¹(−√3/2)
c.  sin⁻¹ 0

notes: Ranges: cos⁻¹ x is in [0, π]; tan⁻¹ x is in the open interval (_______________).
Inverse properties: sin(sin⁻¹ x) = x for −1 ≤ x ≤ 1, but sin⁻¹(sin x) = x only for x in _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find the exact value.
a.  sin⁻¹(sin(9π/8))
b.  tan⁻¹(tan(4π/5))

notes: Solving trig equations: isolate the trig function (factor if needed), then find every solution in one _______________.

blocks.stem:
Solve on 0 ≤ θ < 2π.
a.  2sin²θ − 5sin θ + 3 = 0
b.  2cos²θ − 7cos θ − 4 = 0
